# Benchmark results

Each table is generated from a committed baseline. [Measuring Isomer](index.md) says what each measure claims, and [Sizing a host](sizing.md) turns the numbers into guidance.

## Loading each entry

What `require` of each public entry costs a fresh Node process, as a CommonJS host loads it, before any call into it. Each row adds to `node`, the harness alone; an entry's row includes the packages it pulls in, so rows overlap and don't add up.

Median of 5 runs per scenario. Node v22.22.0, darwin arm64, Apple M4 Pro (14 cores), 48 GB, commit `4760b00e`.

| Scenario                                    | Load (ms) | Modules | Heap held (MB) | RSS after (MB) | Peak RSS (MB) |
| ------------------------------------------- | --------: | ------: | -------------: | -------------: | ------------: |
| `node`                                      |         0 |       0 |            0.0 |             42 |            42 |
| `@elastic/isomer-sdk`                       |        91 |     152 |            7.0 |             67 |            68 |
| `@elastic/isomer-sdk/schema`                |        35 |     108 |            3.8 |             56 |            56 |
| `@elastic/isomer-sdk/html`                  |        46 |     127 |            6.2 |             60 |            60 |
| `@elastic/isomer-sdk/slack`                 |        84 |     127 |            6.2 |             66 |            66 |
| `@elastic/isomer-sdk/text`                  |         2 |       3 |            0.1 |             44 |            44 |
| `@elastic/isomer-sdk/markdown`              |        81 |     110 |            6.0 |             65 |            65 |
| `@elastic/isomer-sdk/react`                 |        83 |     120 |            6.2 |             66 |            66 |
| `@elastic/isomer-sdk/author`                |        39 |     129 |            4.3 |             57 |            57 |
| `@elastic/isomer-runtime`                   |       109 |     219 |            9.7 |             72 |            72 |
| `@elastic/isomer-agent-tools`               |        95 |     170 |            7.3 |             69 |            69 |
| `@elastic/isomer-image-takumi`              |        10 |      16 |            0.7 |             50 |            50 |
| `@elastic/isomer-primitives-charts`         |       134 |     323 |           11.6 |             76 |            76 |
| `@elastic/isomer-primitives-charts/schema`  |        50 |     161 |            6.6 |             62 |            62 |
| `@elastic/isomer-primitives-charts/scene`   |        13 |      49 |            0.9 |             50 |            50 |
| `@elastic/isomer-primitives-charts/resolve` |         9 |      26 |            0.6 |             49 |            49 |
| `@elastic/isomer-charts-elastic`            |       220 |     718 |           16.0 |             95 |            95 |
| `@elastic/isomer-charts-elastic/engine`     |       224 |     717 |           16.0 |             95 |            95 |
| `@elastic/isomer-primitives-slides`         |       209 |     639 |           15.4 |             94 |            94 |

- `node`: nothing: what the harness itself holds
- `host:image`: what a server that draws images loads: the SDK, the runtime, the charts pack and takumi
- `host:agent`: what an agent host loads: the SDK, the runtime, agent-tools and the slides pack

## SDK and runtime overhead

A generated pack whose renderers each return one element or line, so the cost is the SDK's and the runtime's: assembling a runtime (which builds the composition schema), validating, and rendering. Each axis moves alone from 10 primitive types, 100 flat nodes and 800 label characters. Times past the first validate are the median of repeated calls in the same process.

Median of 5 runs per scenario. Node v22.22.0, darwin arm64, Apple M4 Pro (14 cores), 48 GB, commit `4760b00e`.

| Scenario            | Assemble (ms) | Runtime heap (MB) | First validate (ms) | Validate (ms) | HTML (ms) | Text (ms) | Snapshot (ms) | Peak RSS (MB) |

- `primitives-1`: a pack of 1 primitive type
- `primitives-10`: a pack of 10 primitive types
- `primitives-50`: a pack of 50 primitive types

- `nodes-10`: 10 nodes, flat
- `nodes-100`: 100 nodes, flat
- `nodes-1000`: 1000 nodes, flat
- `nodes-4000`: 4000 nodes, flat
- `depth-1`: 100 nodes, 1 of them nested in one chain
- `depth-8`: 100 nodes, 8 of them nested in one chain
- `depth-16`: 100 nodes, 16 of them nested in one chain
- `depth-24`: 100 nodes, 24 of them nested in one chain
- `characters-1000`: 1,000 label characters in all
- `characters-10000`: 10,000 label characters in all
- `characters-100000`: 100,000 label characters in all
- `characters-900000`: 900,000 label characters in all

Each added unit along an axis costs, in microseconds, from the axis's first and last points:

| Axis       | Per                        | Assemble (µs) | Validate (µs) | HTML (µs) | Snapshot (µs) |
| ---------- | -------------------------- | ------------: | ------------: | --------: | ------------: |
| primitives | primitive type in the pack |          74.8 |           0.2 |       0.2 |           0.3 |
| nodes      | node                       |           0.0 |           1.1 |       3.0 |           2.4 |
| depth      | level of nesting           |          -0.8 |           1.5 |       0.5 |           0.8 |
| characters | 1,000 label characters     |           0.2 |           0.0 |       2.0 |           0.3 |
